description: Schema for block-text tool calling format. Avoids JSON escaping issues with code content.
instructions: Output your reasoning in [THOUGHT]...[/THOUGHT] blocks, then invoke tools using [tool_name]...[/tool_name] format wrapped in <tool_code> tags.

format.tool_block:
<tool_code>
[tool_name]
param: value
content:
multiline content here
[/tool_name]
</tool_code>

search.description: Search for a pattern in files using grep

write_file.description: Write content to a file. WARNING: Output FULL file content, no placeholders or truncation.

apply_patch.description: Apply a git-format patch. Prefer this over write_file for small changes to existing files.
apply_patch.example:
[apply_patch]
patch:
--- a/src/main.js
+++ b/src/main.js
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+import { test } from './utils';
 const x = 1;
[/apply_patch]

done.description: Signal that the spec is complete. Call this when you have verified everything works.
done.example:
[done]
summary: Implemented login feature with validation and tests passing
[/done]

app_start.description: Start the dev server and open a browser. MUST call this before any other app_* tools.

app_stop.description: Stop the dev server and close the browser. Call this when done with UI verification.

app_verify_ui.description: Take a screenshot and verify UI criteria using vision model. Returns PASS/FAIL with analysis.
app_verify_ui.example:
[app_verify_ui]
criteria: Navigation shows 6 links, page displays welcome message
[/app_verify_ui]

app_screenshot.description: Take a screenshot of the current page (for debugging). Returns base64 image data.

app_snapshot.description: Get accessibility tree snapshot of the page. Returns element UIDs for interaction.

app_navigate.description: Navigate to a URL or perform browser navigation (back, forward, reload).

app_click.description: Click an element by its UID (get UIDs from app_snapshot).

app_fill.description: Type text into an input field or select an option from a dropdown.

app_hover.description: Hover over an element (useful for dropdowns, tooltips).

app_press_key.description: Press a keyboard key or key combination (Enter, Tab, Ctrl+A, etc.).

app_wait_for.description: Wait for specific text to appear on the page.
app_wait_for.example:
[app_wait_for]
text: Welcome to the app
timeout: 10000
[/app_wait_for]
